title: PageTurn Online Bookstore
subtitle: Flutter Mobile App powered by Supabase Cloud Database
bullets: Comprehensive cross-platform online bookstore developed using Flutter & Dart.
Designed to deliver a seamless mobile shopping experience for book enthusiasts.
Features full authentication, real-time catalog filtering, cart management, and order tracking.
Powered by Supabase for serverless authentication, PostgreSQL database, and Row Level Security (RLS).

title: Problem Statement & Solution
subtitle: Bridging physical book shopping with high-performance mobile UI
bullets: Problem: Traditional bookstore apps often lack responsive UI performance, modern search, or real-time cart persistence.
Problem: Complex backend servers introduce heavy maintenance and slow database queries on mobile devices.
Solution: Flutter cross-platform architecture ensures 60 FPS smooth animations and uniform iOS/Android native feel.
Solution: Supabase PostgreSQL provides instant real-time sync, secure authentication, and scalable relational data storage.

title: Core Application Features
subtitle: Key user journeys requested in project specifications
bullets: 🔐 Authentication: Secure Login and Sign Up with Form Validation & Supabase Auth.
🔥 Best Sellers Page: Featured carousel and top-rated books displayed immediately post-login.
📂 Book Categories Menu: Filterable categories (Tech, Fiction, Science, Finance, Fantasy) with live counters.
🛒 Shopping Cart & Local Cache: Quantity updates, price breakdown, and persistent SharedPreferences sync.
📦 Orders & CRUD Operations: Place orders, track status (Processing, Shipped, Delivered), and cancel pending orders.

title: System Architecture
subtitle: Clean Layered Architecture with Provider State Management
bullets: Presentation Layer: Modular Flutter Widgets, Material 3, Custom Painters, and Hero animations.
State Management Layer: Provider / Riverpod for reactive UI updates across Auth, Cart, Books, and Orders.
Service Layer: SupabaseService handles API calls and local SharedPreferences service manages offline cache.
Backend Database: Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL with row-level policies protecting user orders and credentials.

title: Flutter Technologies & Course Topics
subtitle: Demonstrating mastery of core Flutter concepts
bullets: Layouts & Navigation: Scaffold, CustomScrollView, SliverAppBar, GridView.builder, Named Navigator routes.
State Management & Reactive UI: Provider ChangeNotifier & Consumer patterns for smooth state rebuilds.
Local Storage & Offline Support: SharedPreferences key-value caching for instant offline cart restoration.
Asynchronous Programming & Validation: FutureBuilder, async/await, try-catch error handling, and Form validators.

title: Live Application Demonstration
subtitle: Interactive Mobile App Walkthrough & Device Emulator
bullets: Interactive Flutter Device Simulator in browser with iPhone / Android frame toggles.
Live Supabase Console: Test connection, preview SQL query execution, and monitor active sessions.
Widget Inspector: Inspect Flutter widget hierarchy and state tree in real time.
Live Order CRUD: Test placing an order, changing quantity, and cancelling an order live.

title: Challenges Faced & Solutions
subtitle: Overcoming technical hurdles during development
bullets: Challenge 1: Synchronizing cart state between in-memory Provider and offline SharedPreferences disk cache.
-> Solution: Built a debounced JSON serialization layer in LocalStorageService with fail-safe error recovery.
Challenge 2: Securing relational order items in Supabase while preserving user privacy.
-> Solution: Implemented Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) policies matching auth.uid() = user_id.
Challenge 3: Maintaining responsive grid layouts across varying screen densities.
-> Solution: Created flexible LayoutBuilder dynamic grid count calculations.
